The separate note block works well, and falling back to the site name when the title is empty is reasonable. Cancel should continue to discard every unsaved change.

Two things are missing before I’d approve editing:

- I need to be able to change the link address itself, not only its title and description. If the corrected address is already saved elsewhere, it should avoid creating a duplicate.
- Notes should support simple formatting such as headings, bold text, lists, and links, and display that formatting when I’m viewing the entry.

I’d also like a brief chance to review and correct the automatically collected title and description before completing a new save, as well as being able to edit them afterward.
